senses.gloss:
पूय् {c1c} U. (पूयति-ते)
1 To stink,
putrefy.
--2 To split up, divide.
--3
To be dissolved; (considered by
some to be {c4c} A. also).

पूयः --यं Pus, discharge from an
ulcer or wound, suppuration, matter;
Ms. 3. 180; 4. 220; 12. 72.
--Comp.
[]
--अरिः the Nimba tree.
--रक्तः a
kind of disease of the nose (wherein
purulent blood or sanies flow
out).
--(क्तं) {1} ichor, sanies.
{2} discharge of sanies from the
nostrils.
